Multi-STATE: RMXP animates it with code-41 Change Graphic steps that keep the sheet and move only (direction, pattern), so every non-empty grid cell is emitted as its own graphics-info + gfx id (see 'states'); the idle cell (2,0) keeps the bare constant. sprite_pass cross-checks these against the real PNG's non-empty cells and fails loud on drift
